facts.fact: Decree 2024-073 of 15 May 2024 makes every poor household enrolled in the Registre Social eligible for Tekavoul's regular transfers (articles 11) and every vulnerable enrolled household eligible for its shock-response transfers (article 13), so the programme's regular and Tekavoul Choc components both draw beneficiaries from the Registre Social.
